# MixinExtras expressions

The native Rust implementation in `mcdev-core/src/expression_engine/` derives from
LlamaLad7's MixinExtras expressions 0.0.6 grammar, AST, value-flow interpreter,
postprocessors and identifier pool. The accompanying MIT license is
`MixinExtras-LICENSE`.

Authoritative source: Maven Central coordinate
`io.github.llamalad7:mixinextras-expressions:0.0.6:sources`.
Source archive: `build/migration-reference/mixinextras-expressions-0.0.6-sources.jar`.
SHA-256: `86d4c226b843a7b7dc08f968e7d2707aa5f21e482a915acbf7f834e2b4ac8d50`.
Primary archive URL:
<https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/io/github/llamalad7/mixinextras-expressions/0.0.6/mixinextras-expressions-0.0.6-sources.jar>.

License text was obtained from the upstream repository
<https://github.com/LlamaLad7/MixinExtras> at commit
`613b418327594c46ef13ee28971baa5d804462cc`.
The Maven source archive takes precedence over the repository when they differ.

This is a native implementation; the Java runtime and ANTLR Java implementation
are not invoked or distributed as an execution dependency.
